# C&D Plumbing Plus

> Owner-operated, family-run plumbing company serving Rochester, NY and Monroe County since 2018. Founded by Chris Alexander — known locally as "The Plumbing Professor" for explaining every repair in plain English, quoting flat rates before any work begins, and never upselling. Two-time Nextdoor Neighborhood Favorite (2023, 2024). 100% recommended on Facebook. Licensed and insured in New York State.

## About
- [About C&D Plumbing Plus](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#about): Owner story, family business background, service philosophy
- [The Plumbing Professor approach](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#why): Education-first, no-upsell repair model
- [Pricing Promise](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#pricing): Flat-rate, written quote before any work begins

## Services
- [Water Heater Repair & Replacement](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): Tank, tankless, gas, electric. Bradford White, Rinnai, Navien, AO Smith installation in Rochester NY.
- [Tankless Water Heater Installation](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): Rinnai and Navien certified, Rochester NY
- [Sump Pump Installation & Repair](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): Primary and battery-backup pumps. Critical for Rochester basements during spring snowmelt.
- [Drain Cleaning & Clogged Drains](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): Snaking, camera inspection, hydro-jet referral
- [Sewer Line Repair (Cast Iron & Trenchless)](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): Sewer camera inspection, trenchless options, full pipe replacement
- [Boiler Service & Repair](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): Leaks, low pressure, expansion tanks, zone valves
- [Backflow Testing (Monroe County)](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): NYS-certified backflow tester, county paperwork filed for you
- [Faucets, Toilets & Fixtures](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): Install, repair, replace — kitchen, bath, outdoor hose bibs
- [Frozen & Burst Pipe Repair](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): Winter emergency response across Monroe County
- [Emergency Plumbing](https://cdplumbingplus.com/#services): Same-day service for existing customers and true emergencies
